name: done-prepare-done-gate-parity
title: Make done_prepare enforce the real DONE finish-decision and reviewer-verdict predicates
description: Fix the confirmed done_prepare/DONE predicate-parity defect exposed by B-aa5f. The Story must commit the already-designed executable RED that proves real DONE rejects a missing dev_memory_finish_decision and a stale reviewer scopeBinding.diffPackHash while done_prepare currently omits both blocker rows; then implement a shared or mechanically parity-guarded predicate path so the unchanged test becomes GREEN with matching missing_dev_memory_finish_decision and stale_closeout_review codes. The temporary GREEN candidate is design evidence only, not delivery evidence. During development, classify every new defect before changing scope: repair current-Story critical/high, security, data-integrity, destructive-compatibility, acceptance-blocking, or lifecycle-truth defects immediately; record reproducible medium/low non-blockers with evidence, impact, recommendation, and a traceable later owner through finding/gap/backlog without expanding scope; reassess and bring a deferred defect back when later evidence raises severity or makes it block acceptance, REVIEW, TEST, or DONE.
